Question: Right triangles \(T_1\) and \(T_2\) have areas \(1\) and \(2\), respectively. A side of \(T_1\) is congruent to a side of \(T_2,\) and a different side of \(T_1\) is congruent to a different side of \(T_2.\) What is the square of the product of the lengths of the other (third) sides of \(T_1\) and \(T_2?\)
